Never stored or split — preserve it separately.
Turn your seed phrase into N shares. Any T of them restore the wallet — nothing leaves this device.
Note this fingerprint — restore must reproduce it. It is computed only from your seed + passphrase.

Optional — filled into your Recovery Guide

Paste your seed shares (one SLIP-39 share per line) to reconstruct the original seed phrase.
This fingerprint is derived from your seed — confirm it matches the one noted at split time.
This fingerprint is derived from your seed + passphrase — confirm it matches the one noted at split time.
Not enough shares: you need at least the split threshold, and each share must be correct.
These shares are not from the same wallet (mismatched identifiers).
Checksum failed: one or more shares are incorrect (a wrong or corrupted word).
A share has too few words to be a valid SLIP-39 share.
Keep each share in a separate, secure location. Any %1$d of %2$d restore the wallet. Write them down — S4 never stores them.
Keep each share in a separate, secure location. Write them down — S4 never stores them.
This wallet uses a BIP-39 passphrase. The shares recover only the seed words — the passphrase must be kept separately.
Copy the full seed to the clipboard?

This copies every share — the complete seed — to the system clipboard, where it can be read by other apps (keyboards, accessibility tools) and persists after this app closes. Only proceed if you trust this device.
Copy this and write it by hand next to your shares — your beneficiary can recover the wallet with any SLIP-39 + BIP-39 tool, no app needed.
Copy the guide to the clipboard?

This guide embeds the wallet\'s entropy — byte-equivalent to the seed itself — and is copied to the system clipboard, where it can be read by other apps (keyboards, accessibility tools) and persists after this app closes. Only proceed if you trust this device.
